faq.question: Is this 3ds Max course suitable for beginners?
faq.answer: Yes. The course starts with 3ds Max fundamentals, scene navigation and architectural drawing orientation before progressing to precision modeling and residential interior projects.

faq.question: What will I learn?
faq.answer: You will learn Editable Poly modeling, splines, modifiers, CAD-to-3D workflows, architectural structures, furniture modeling, basic materials, camera setup and scene preparation.

faq.question: Do I need AutoCAD experience?
faq.answer: No advanced AutoCAD knowledge is mandatory. The course uses supplied architectural references and includes an orientation for learners who are unfamiliar with architectural drawings.

faq.question: Will I learn to create 3D models from floor plans?
faq.answer: Yes. You will learn how to interpret supplied drawing references and build walls, floors, ceilings, doors, windows and other architectural elements.

faq.question: What portfolio project will I create?
faq.answer: You will create one complete modeled residential interior with architectural details, selected furniture, organized materials, camera viewpoints, editable source files and a modeling breakdown.

faq.question: Will I learn Smart Bevel?
faq.answer: Yes, where a supported 3ds Max 2027 installation is available. The course also teaches suitable traditional bevel and Chamfer workflows for compatibility.

faq.question: Will I learn materials and rendering?
faq.answer: You will learn basic material assignment, UVW mapping, OpenPBR awareness, camera setup and introductory native Arnold previews. Advanced photorealistic rendering is covered separately.

faq.question: Is V-Ray included?
faq.answer: V-Ray is not a mandatory tool in this certification. Specialist V-Ray rendering belongs to Course 75.

faq.question: Will I learn architectural walkthroughs?
faq.answer: This course focuses on accurate 3D modeling and scene preparation. Real-time walkthrough creation is covered separately in Course 76.

faq.question: Can I use downloaded furniture assets?
faq.answer: Authorized assets may support scene assembly, but students must also demonstrate original modeling skills. Downloaded models alone do not satisfy the capstone.

faq.question: Do I need an architecture degree?
faq.answer: No. Basic computer knowledge is sufficient to begin. Architectural drawing familiarity is helpful, and an orientation is provided where needed.

faq.question: Will I receive editable project files?
faq.answer: Students will create and submit editable 3ds Max project files, organized assets, modeling evidence and presentation previews.

faq.question: Is Autodesk 3ds Max free?
faq.answer: 3ds Max is commercial software. Trial, educational or subscription access depends on Autodesk's applicable terms. Do not promise a free commercial license.

faq.question: Does this course teach interior design?
faq.answer: The course focuses on modeling architectural and interior scenes, not the complete professional discipline of interior design.

faq.question: What is the course duration and fee?
faq.answer: The course runs for eight weeks, includes 64 guided learning hours and has a listed fee of ₹10,900, subject to Nova Skills' verified pricing and tax policy.
